what_was_already_seen: the audit reproductions only: CORE-001 affine fit to quadratic truth (chi2 8204 on 10 dof); CORE-002 a parameter with no effect on the data on a 21x21 supplied grid, and an affine posterior on a +/-0.6 sd box; CORE-003 a posterior Gaussian to 2.05 sd with chi2 rising 0.01 per sd beyond; CORE-005 a grid from data shifted by +5 under the request's dataset id
no committed evidence (TCR, FAILURE_CASES, PERFORMANCE, BATTERY_T41, KINETICS_K2) has been scored under any rule below

threshold_classes.A: a mathematical guarantee under the stated model
threshold_classes.B: a statistical convention with a stated error rate under the stated model
threshold_classes.C: an engineering heuristic; recorded as such, and never described as a guarantee

goodness_of_fit.statistic: chi2_min, the sum of squared standardized residuals at the calibrated estimate (local route) or the smallest over admissible grid nodes (grid routes, an upper bound on the minimum), on dof = n - p
goodness_of_fit.tests: p = chi2.sf(chi2_min, dof) under the declared independent Gaussian noise; variance ratio v = chi2_min / dof
goodness_of_fit.alpha_why: the value HELD_OUT_CHI_SQUARE_ALPHA already declares for held-out validation in this repository; not chosen for this batch
goodness_of_fit.refuse_variance_ratio_why: v > 4 means the residual scatter exceeds twice the declared sigma, so the reported standard deviations are understated by more than a factor 2 even under the most charitable rescaling; a covariance that wrong is not emitted
goodness_of_fit.not_gated: under-dispersion (p > 1 - alpha): the declared sigma is too large, the reported uncertainty is conservative, and conservatism is not false confidence
goodness_of_fit.grid_routes: a grid claim is SUPPORTED or absent, so either reason passes the grid route over (supplied or rebuilt); a local route carrying either reason is never rebuilt into a grid
goodness_of_fit.record: the chi2_min a route measured is carried in its diagnostics so the reason is re-derived on read

tail_probes.where: along every principal axis of the local covariance, both signs, at radii 3 and 6 posterior sd: 4p forward evaluations beyond the existing 2p^2
tail_probes.statistic: rise ratio = (chi2(z) - chi2_min) / r^2, which is 1 for the Gaussian the route reports
tail_probes.direction: only a SHORTFALL is gated: a rise below r^2 means more mass beyond r than the Gaussian reports; a rise above it means less, which makes the reported interval conservative
tail_probes.why_these_values: the existing NONLINEARITY_DOWNGRADE (0.10) and NONLINEARITY_REFUSE (0.50), applied to the shortfall side only; no new number is introduced
tail_probes.probe_outside_declared_bounds: not evaluated and not counted as skipped: no posterior mass lies beyond a declared bound
tail_probes.probe_refused_by_forward: counted as not evaluated; the route adds NONLINEARITY_PROBE_INCOMPLETE
tail_probes.stated_residual: any finite probe set can be evaded: a plateau placed strictly between probe radii, or beyond 6 sd with bounds more than about 1e6 sd away, is not seen. The claim is local by construction and the record says which radii were probed

supplied_grid_binding.requires: observations AND forward; a supplied grid without both is passed over GRID_NOT_BOUND_TO_EVIDENCE
supplied_grid_binding.check: at deterministic nodes -- the grid's first and last node, its highest-likelihood node, the node nearest the calibrated estimate when a calibration is given, and four interior nodes chosen from a digest of the grid's own bytes -- the forward evaluator's admission must equal the grid's mask, and the chi2 recomputed from the forward evaluator and the observations must equal the grid's
supplied_grid_binding.tolerance: |chi2_grid - chi2_forward| <= 2e-6 * sqrt(n * chi2_forward) + n * 1e-12 + 1e-9, i.e. every standardized residual agreeing to 1e-6 sd, the agreement SUPPLIED_PREDICTION_AGREEMENT_SD already declares
supplied_grid_binding.tolerance_class: A (numerical agreement of one computation with itself)
supplied_grid_binding.on_mismatch: HybridUQError, as HUQ-06 does for a grid over other parameters: a grid of other evidence is a malformed request, not a route to pass over
supplied_grid_binding.stated_residual: a grid altered only at unchecked nodes is not caught (the HUQ-05 residual, now shared by supplied grids)

supplied_grid_containment.rule: the rebuilt grid's containment rule, EDGE_LOG_LIKELIHOOD_DROP = ln 1e6, applied to every face of a supplied tensor grid
supplied_grid_containment.declared_bound_faces: known only when a calibration is given. A supplied grid whose posterior reaches a face that is a declared bound is still passed over: truncation convergence needs refinement, which only a rebuild can do
supplied_grid_containment.bound_dominated: on a REBUILT grid, an axis whose posterior reaches BOTH declared bounds is passed over GRID_POSTERIOR_BOUND_DOMINATED: the data rule out no part of the declared range at the 1e-6 density level, so the width reported for it is the range's, not the data's

standalone_grid_predictive.rule: grid_predictive_uncertainty gains keyword arguments observations=None and forward=None. With both, the grid is held to the three grid rules above and a pass keeps SUPPORTED; without them the record is DOWNGRADED with GRID_NOT_BOUND_TO_EVIDENCE

moves: RouteReason gains MODEL_MISFIT_BEYOND_DECLARED_NOISE, RESIDUALS_EXCEED_DECLARED_NOISE, TAIL_HEAVIER_THAN_LOCAL_GAUSSIAN, TAIL_HEAVIER_WITHIN_6_SD, GRID_NOT_BOUND_TO_EVIDENCE, GRID_DOES_NOT_CONTAIN_POSTERIOR, GRID_POSTERIOR_BOUND_DOMINATED
RouteDiagnostics gains trailing defaulted fields for chi2_min and the tail probes; its schema becomes hybrid_uq.route_diagnostics/2
grid_predictive_uncertainty gains two defaulted keyword arguments
compatibility.classification: MINOR by docs/CORE_FREEZE_POLICY.md section 4 (members, fields and defaulted arguments added), but a change of claim semantics: records that were SUPPORTED can now be DOWNGRADED or REFUSED
compatibility.consequence: the Core Freeze V3 verifier's vocabulary and frozen-surface checks fail on this batch by design; the batch is certified in Core Freeze V4, after batches 2 and 3
compatibility.legacy_records: a hybrid_uq.route_diagnostics/1 record carries no chi2_min, so a goodness-of-fit reason cannot be re-derived from it; such a record is refused on read unless its route was REFUSED before measuring anything
